name: EMC Home of Data - Rechenzentrum Rosenheim
notes: Official EMC page describes its Rosenheim data center for the Alpine region, direct connection to Campus MUC 1, PUE under 1.3, waste-heat use for the Kathrein campus, redundant power, Argon fire suppression, and racks up to 9 kW.

name: roNet Aicherpark data center
notes: roNet states it has operated an Internet POP in Rosenheim since 1996 and offers hosting/housing; its backup page states storage is in its Rosenheim data center. roNet's archive refers to guided tours through its Rechenzentrum im Aicherpark; Cloudscene lists roNet Aicherpark in Rosenheim.

name: KommunalBIT legacy Schwabach municipal data center
notes: KommunalBIT history says the organization began on 2010-01-01 with three locations, each with a data center, before consolidation into a central infrastructure. Schwabach's digital strategy says the city founded KommunalBIT with Fuerth and Erlangen in 2010 and uses it as an external IT infrastructure provider. Current physical status of any Schwabach-local facility is not clear, so status is unknown.

name: Blue Swan AI Gigafactory / Conn Barracks data center
developer: Blue Swan consortium: Free State of Bavaria, Leibniz-Rechenzentrum/BAdW, Investa; Blue Swan Service GmbH planned as operator vehicle
notes: Bavarian government describes Blue Swan as an AI Gigafactory concept in the EU competition, using the Schweinfurt site for available land, grid power, and fiber, with LRZ as coordinator/competence holder and Investa contributing data center development expertise. District/Geldersheim planning pages document the Conn Barracks Blue Swan land-use process. The 220 MW figure appears in public planning consultation material quoting project assumptions; other official pages emphasize 100,000 GPUs but do not state MW.

name: ODAV AG Rechenzentrum
notes: ODAV's official page advertises 'Unser Rechenzentrum' and lists ODAV AG at Ernst-Heinkel-Strasse 11, 94315 Straubing. No capacity figure found.
